findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies locking the account after failed login attempts but omits the lockout duration, unlock/recovery procedure, and the response shown on subsequent login attempts.

findings.evidence: notify him by email
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has multiple plausible antecedents (the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor), leaving the email recipient ambiguous.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of specifying the concrete password-reset token expiration duration.

findings.evidence: user-friendly; easy to navigate; loads rapidly; standard connections
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') without measurable acceptance criteria or latency/bandwidth thresholds.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of defining the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Describes only the happy path for barcode scanning and eligibility validation without specifying system behavior or error handling when an item is ineligible or the barcode scan fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a maximum limit on active hold requests without specifying the actual numeric cap.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Permits borrowing up to 8 physical items simultaneously, contradicting SD-009 which caps simultaneous checkouts at 5 physical items.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days from the checkout timestamp
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, contradicting SD-010 which sets it to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: Unverified visitors shall be able to self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification.
findings.rationale: Allows unverified online self-registration with only an email address and immediate checkout, directly contradicting SD-001 which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email, and phone number before creating an account.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Requires reserved items on the pickup shelf to be held indefinitely until cancelled by the Member, contradicting SD-011 which automatically cancels uncollected holds after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Chained 'and/or' connectives make it ambiguous which combination of actions is required and under what conditions each action triggers.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which role or system component is responsible for reviewing, approving, and recording fine waiver requests.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: The non-binding qualifier 'if appropriate' leaves the conditions for dispatching SMS due-date alerts subjective and unverifiable.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of specifying the retention period for payment receipts.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap on accumulated fines
findings.rationale: Sets an overdue fine of $1.25 USD/day with no cap, contradicting SD-019 which sets the fine to $0.50 USD/day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: permitted to renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Allows renewing items regardless of unpaid overdue fine balance, contradicting SD-020 which blocks Members with unpaid fines exceeding $5.00 USD from borrowing or renewing items.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count; Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Introduces the term 'Patron' for the library borrower role instead of the established term 'Member' used in SD-001, SD-009, and earlier requirements.

findings.evidence: quickly; many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified performance and load terms ('quickly', 'many users') without specifying target response latency or concurrent user count.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: The weak qualifier 'where possible' makes term highlighting optional and fails to define the conditions under which highlighting is required.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy; acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('sufficient', 'acceptable') without defining measurable accuracy or response-time thresholds.

findings.evidence: efficiently; large batch MARC21 files; noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('efficiently', 'large', 'noticeable system slowdown') without specifying file size, throughput, or performance degradation limits.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Specifies detecting active loans or holds on deletion attempts but omits the resulting system action (e.g., blocking deletion and returning an error message).

findings.evidence: at TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Uses the placeholder 'TBD' instead of defining the scheduled backup frequency.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions; timely manner; appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('important', 'timely manner', 'appropriate period') without enumerating audited actions, recording latency, or retention duration.

findings.evidence: If the primary database node becomes unreachable for more than 10 seconds, the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01.
findings.rationale: Specifies only logging event FAILOVER-01 upon primary database failure without defining the actual failover, replica promotion, alerting, or recovery behavior.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security; clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('adequate', 'clear') without specifying concrete security protocols (e.g., TLS version) or error message criteria.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any password of at least 8 characters, contradicting SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Sets the web portal session inactivity timeout to 60 minutes, contradicting SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 encryption so passwords can be decrypted, directly contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing (cost factor 12) and prohibits storing plaintext passwords.
